session: London open for Gold and Oil — NY session for resource stocks

rules.geopolitical_check: Always check geopolitical news before trading commodities — Strait of Hormuz, OPEC decisions, war news

gold.support_rule: Buy on touch of $4,644 or $4,700 support
gold.resistance_rule: Buy continuation on breakout above $4,800 or $4,858

rules.oil: Driven by Strait of Hormuz and OPEC — buy on supply disruption news
rules.copper: AI and EV demand driver — buy on dips during AI infrastructure buildout
rules.silver: Inflation hedge and AI solar demand — buy when CPI data comes in hot
rules.uranium: CCJ and UUUU — buy on nuclear energy policy news
rules.rare_earth: MP — buy on China export restriction news
rules.position_size: 1% of portfolio per trade — calculate units properly
rules.swing_alert: Always include a SWING ALERT if overnight move was greater than 1%
